fato_historico: 1959: Portugal's state police force PIDE fires upon striking workers in Bissau, Portuguese Guinea, killing over 50 people.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on strength and persistence. Like seeds sprouting through concrete, your spirit may find new ways to rise. Honor those who stood firm in the past, letting their legacy of endurance inspire your own journey toward stability and peace. It is a good time to cultivate compassion within your ambitious heart.
frase_do_dia: Stand tall, for even the strongest roots once faced the harshest storms.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of success and karmic balance.
conselho: Consider using your natural determination to foster healing conversations with those around you.
